pub fn store_value(value: &LocalValue) -> *mut std::ffi::c_void {
    unsafe {
        std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(value, &mut LOCAL_VALUE, 1);
        match binn_get_read_storage(value.type_) {
            0x00 | 0x40 | 0x60 | 0x80 => &mut LOCAL_VALUE.vint32 as *mut i32 as *mut std::ffi::c_void,
            _ => value.ptr,
        }
    }
}
